notes.title: Harbinger Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45127878/12609422d3494fa81efd733fe5733ce4d2e76a42.png

Hello everyone!

Today, we are dropping the harbinger update for Goblin Quest remastered.

This free update to the game adds the characters and realm of the Soulstream into the game.

The Soulstream is a late-game dungeon where players can obtain new powerful characters to enlist as supporters.

The Soulstream was first introduced in our game, Soulivion, and now you can return to it in full.

Head north in the first woods you arrive at after gaining freedom and travel to the forest heart.

We hope everybody enjoys the free update. Feel free to send us any good or bad messages or inform us about bug fixes through our email.

Thank you for your time, and enjoy the game!

notes.title: Friday Update!
notes.notes:
​Thank you all for playing our game!

We fixed a couple of things for the remake build to make the game better for our players.
Here is the list!


 Fixed Marvow’s Chief and Right Hand assignment.
 Fixed Shamrock throne room doorway
 Fixed Scarlet Stronghold Puzzle
 Fixed Forlorn Stairs
 Fixed Armor Stats issue
 Cut off Demon Gateway Area


​If you find any other bugs with the game let us know by email or review so we can improve it.
